newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Michael Jackson holds first Africa concert.
newsitem.headline: Michael Jackson holds first Africa concert.

text.p: Pop star Michael Jackson performed for the first time in Africa on Monday night, entertaining more than 60,000 fans in Tunis on his world tour "HIStory II".
"I love you all," Jackson shouted, sparking hysteria among the packed crowd. A dozen or so fainted.

"This concert will be of special significance fo me because it will be my first in Africa and the Arab World. The people and nations of both regions have always held a special place in my heart and I always wanted to perform for them," Jackson said in a statement before the concert.
The American star said proceeds from the concert would go to a Tunisian national charity for the poor.
